newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian bank to offers loans for investment.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian bank to offers loans for investment.

text.p: State-owned Development Bank of Ethiopia said on Thursday it would grant loans totalling $127 million to promote investment in the agro-industrial sector.
The bank said the loans would go to private investors active in agriculture, industry and tourism development. It said the scheme was effective from Wednesday September 11.
September 11 marked Ethiopia's new year, 1989, under the Orthodox Christian tabulation of the Julian Calender.
The bank said it would also advance loans to cooperatives and state development enterprises engaged in the development of agriculture and industry.

Ethiopia launced a five-year development programme last year to accelerate the economy devastated by civil war and 17 years of Marxist rule. The government has pledged food sufficiency by the end of 1997.
